name: starbucks_get_item_calories
intent: Look up the calories for a Starbucks menu item in a chosen size
description: Open the Starbucks menu without selecting a café, search for a menu item, open its product page for the requested size, and read the calorie count shown there.
patterns: how many calories are in a menu item
what is the calorie count for a drink
check the calories for an item and size

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Requested size of the menu item

steps.intent: Tap Order to open the menu
Skip selecting a café so the menu can be browsed
Confirm skipping directly to the menu
Tap the {{drink_name}} result to open its product page and read the calories for the {{size}} size
